name: dsh-control
description: Connect Codex to local DeepSeek Harness projects and conversations; transmit messages unchanged and return observable results.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to local DeepSeek Harness conversations
interface.longDescription: Fifteen connection tools select projects and sessions, transmit caller messages unchanged, relay questions and approvals, and return durable results. Task roles and working methods come from the conversation and project, not this plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the DeepSeek Harness connection and send my message to the intended project and conversation.
